rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Benzene's chemistry is one mechanism worn by many electrophiles: NO₂⁺ (nitration), SO₃ (sulphonation), X⁺/FeX₃ (halogenation), R⁺/AlCl₃ and RCO⁺/AlCl₃ (Friedel–Crafts) — attack forms the σ-complex, deprotonation restores the sextet, and the regained resonance energy drives step three. Addition survives only under forcing conditions (Ni, UV) because it must repay 150 kJ/mol.…

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Step 3 of every substitution is driven by the regained resonance energy - aromaticity is the reaction's engine.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: ***The halogen paradox*** - deactivating inductively, o/p-directing by resonance: the one substituent that proves reactivity and regiochemistry are independent axes.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: ## 1. Topic Introduction — Benzene's Chemistry: Two Doors, One Preference Benzene reacts by **addition** (H₂/Ni, X₂/UV, O₃) only under forcing conditions, and by **electrophilic substitution** (nitration, sulphonation, halogenation, Friedel–Crafts) readily — the preference is the resonance energy at work. Orientation in disubstitution follows the director classification: o/p versus meta.  ·  ## 2. Theorem Mirror - **Addition routes:** hydrogenation C₆H₆ + 3H₂ --(Ni, 475 K)--> C₆H₆H₁₂ (cyclohexane); halogen addition C₆H₆ + 3Cl₂ --(UV/sunlight)--> C₆H₆Cl₆ (benzene hexachloride, BHC); ozonolysis → tri-ozonide → hydrolysis gives 3 glyoxal (proving the three-bond skeleton).…

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Mechanism marks: name the sigma-complex, draw its resonance forms, show H+ leaving - three pictures, full credit.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: **NEB 2022 (3m): Give the reaction of benzene with (a) a mixture of concentrated nitric and sulphuric acids, (b) fuming sulphuric acid.** — **(a) Nitration:** C₆H₆ + HNO₃ --(conc H₂SO₄, 50–60 °C)--> **C₆H₅NO₂ (nitrobenzene)** + H₂O. The sulphuric acid generates the electrophile: HNO₃ + 2H₂SO₄ ⇌ NO₂⁺ + H₃O⁺ + 2HSO₄⁻.…  ·  **NEB 2024 (4m): Describe the mechanism of nitration of benzene.** — **Step 1 — electrophile generation:** HNO₃ + 2H₂SO₄ ⇌ NO₂⁺ + H₃O⁺ + 2HSO₄⁻ — the sulphuric acid protonates nitric acid (H₂NO₃⁺), which loses water to give the nitronium ion NO₂⁺ (linear, O=N=O).…

rows.label: Hints
rows.text: Always pair the equation with its catalyst/condition: H2SO4 for nitration, FeCl3 for chlorination, AlCl3 for Friedel-Crafts, UV for addition.

rows.label: Quick concepts
rows.text: Orientation is sigma-complex bookkeeping - the director's verdict is read in which resonance forms carry the positive charge.

rows.label: Key points
rows.text: Addition (forcing): H2/Ni 475 K -> cyclohexane; 3Cl2/UV -> BHC C6H6Cl6; O3 -> triozonide -> 3 glyoxal. Substitution (ready): nitration (NO2+ from HNO3+2H2SO4), sulphonation (SO3), halogenation (X2/FeX3), Friedel-Crafts alkylation (R-Cl/AlCl3) and acylation (RCOCl/AlCl3).…

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: Acylation beats alkylation for clean mono-products - the acylium ion neither rearranges nor reactivates the ring.
